description: This file is a markdown summary/documentation of the cart routes implementation for a FastAPI-based e-commerce backend. It describes the endpoints, architecture, security, error handling, response models, testing, and other technical details about the cart management API, referencing the implementation in `src/api/routes/cart_routes.py`.

classes.name: CartResponse
classes.description: Response model representing a user's shopping cart, including items, total amount, item count, creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: CartItemRequest
classes.description: Request model for adding a new item to the cart, containing product ID, name, price, and quantity.

classes.name: UpdateQuantityRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Depends function to extract the current user from JWT token (used as dependency in routes).

methods.name: get_user_cart
methods.description: Service layer method to retrieve or create the cart for a user.

methods.name: add_item_to_cart
methods.description: Service method to add or update an item in the user's cart.

methods.name: update_cart_item
methods.description: Service method to update the quantity of a specific item in the cart.

methods.name: remove_cart_item
methods.description: Service method to remove an item from the cart.

methods.name: clear_user_cart
methods.description: Service method to clear all items from the user's cart.
